svg.text: FINAL LOOK - from the south-west, everything stowed
Charcoal Baltic-birch fronts with routed finger pulls, maple-edged 1-1/2" top at 34-3/4". Miter saw hangs upside down under its flush box; only the router plate, T-track, dog field and vise show.
West face (left): face vise, dog field, hand-tool drawers, laser tray. South face (right): long drawers, two flip-bay doors with the miter paddle, clamp-rack pull-out.
Drop-leaf wings hang flat against both ends. LED strip under the top overhang. The table saw sits against the far (north) edge.
